Note to the Council from the Asiatic
Society. - 16/4/26. 20 APR REC'D (---)

The writer gives a summary of the connexions of General Feng Yu-
hsing with the Soviet Government relating to the supply of arms and
money for bolshevik propaganda in China.

（印：整 Y. D. REG No. ... /14/26）

for perusal & return

Translation of a Booklet entitled "Feng Yu Hsiang's
'Red' Intrigues Revealed" (馮玉祥赤化陰謀大披露), Published
by the Chung Hwa Citizens' Anti-Bolshevik Society.

Feng Yu Hsiang's "Red" Intrigues Revealed.

Feng Yu Hsiang is noted for his many intrigues which
have now been discovered, and the people are of the opinion
unanimously that he deserves to be decapitated. Being
surrounded by enemies at a time when no possible assistance
could be secured, Feng began to lead a new career by
co-operating with Soviet Russia whose policy then was to
make the whole of China red. The fact that Soviet Russia
is seriously assisting Feng cannot by any means be denied.
A section of the people, however, has been misled by Feng
Yu Hsiang's tricky manner of propaganda. These persons
claim that Feng has no "red" leanings, but support the
argument that he is simply exploiting Soviet Russia.
However, they do not seem to realize that although Feng
does not entertain Bolshevik ideas; it is plain that his
ambitions are to make use of Soviet Russia's help in order
to secure complete control of China. The following
information will show that this is true.
Soviet Russia has employed the "Left" wing of the
Kuomintang Party to Bolshevise Canton. She has caused
the continuation of China's internecine warfare and has
instigated strikes and anti-foreign agitations. All these
activities are responsible for the present situation at
Canton. If we would but ponder over this, as also over
Kuo Sung Ling's military counter-operations in the North-east
last year and Soviet Ambassador Karahan's movements, there
would then be no doubt whatever that Feng Yu Hsiang, in
his present relations with Soviet Russia, has willingly lent
his services to the devils and heartlessly betrayed his
own country. Recent events are of such importance that they
ought to be carefully studied. The following report, made
by members of the Investigation Department of our Society
from personal investigations, is published here for the
information of the people.

U.S.S.R.'s Relations with Feng Yu Hsiang of the
Kuominchun Army.
A. The Supply of Arms.
According to information secured by the British Legation,
Soviet Russia and Feng signed a secret pact whereby the
former undertake to furnish the latter with a loan of three
million Gold Roubles in the form of munitions. These munitions
are on their way from Urga to Kalgan. On January 29 last
the following report was read at the "Soviet Club" in the
Old Russian Concession, Tientsin :-
"The Revolutionary Committee at Urga has decided to
"join Soviet Russia's All Mongolian Conference on
"March 1. A meeting was held (by the committee) on
"January 17 when a report was read on the revolutionary
"movement in the Far East. This report stated that
"the greater portion of the three million gold Rouble
"munitions loan has already been delivered to Feng Yu
"Hsiang."
On the same day (January 29) a notice was received at the
Tientsin Branch of the Soviet Commercial Union to the effect
that transportation of a consignment of Mongolian wool for

中华公民反布尔什维克协会出版的小册子《冯玉祥赤化阴谋大披露》译文。

冯玉祥“赤色”阴谋大披露。

冯玉祥以其众多的阴谋诡计而闻名，这些阴谋现已被揭露，民众一致意见认为他罪该万死。冯玉祥在四面受敌、无法获得任何援助之际，开始通过与苏联合作开启新的生涯，而苏联当时的政策是使整个中国变红。苏联正在认真援助冯玉祥这一事实不容否认。然而，一部分民众被冯玉祥狡猾的宣传手段所误导。这些人声称冯玉祥没有“赤色”倾向，并支持这样一种论点，即他只是在利用苏联。然而，他们似乎没有意识到，虽然冯玉祥并不持有布尔什维克思想；但显而易见的是，他的野心是利用苏联的帮助以确保对中国的完全控制。以下信息将证明这是事实。
苏联利用国民党“左”翼使广州布尔什维克化。她导致中国内战持续不断，并煽动罢工和排外运动。所有这些活动都是造成目前广州局势的原因。如果我们仔细思考这一点，以及去年郭松龄在东北的军事反戈行动和苏联大使加拉罕（Karahan）的动向，那么就毫无疑问，冯玉祥在与苏联目前的交往中，甘愿为魔鬼效力，无情地背叛了自己的国家。最近的事件如此重要，值得认真研究。以下报告由本会调查部成员通过个人调查制成，现予公布，以供民众知晓。

苏联与国民军冯玉祥的关系。
A. 武器供应。
根据英国公使馆获得的情报，苏联与冯玉祥签订了一项秘密协定，据此前者承诺以军火形式向后者提供三百万金卢布的贷款。这批军火正从库伦（Urga）运往张家口（Kalgan）。上月1月29日，在天津旧俄租界的“苏维埃俱乐部”宣读了以下报告：
“库伦革命委员会已决定于
“3月1日加入苏联的全蒙古会议。委员会于
“1月17日举行会议，会上宣读了一份关于远东
“革命运动的报告。该报告指出，三百万金卢布
“军火贷款的大部分已经交付给冯玉
“祥。”
同日（1月29日），苏联商业联合会天津分会收到通知，称一批运往

2. Amount of Loan : 5,000,000 Gold Roubles.
3. Security : No specific articles, but the following conditions were made :-
(a) That Russian and Mongolian goods transported by the Soviet Commercial Union into China or passing through China to be exempt from tax.
(b) That Soviet Russia be given the monopoly for trading and transportation of goodsbetween China and Mongolia.
4. Conditions of Reimbursement : No reimbursement to be made within the term of five years, but the loan must be reimbursed beginning from the sixth year and must be completed within three years.
5. Purpose of the Loan : The loan represents the price of munitions purchased and supplied to Feng Yu Hsiang.
6. Appendix :
(a) In addition to furnishing the munitions, Soviet Russia will also send 21 flying instructors and officers, and other trainers or artisans for cavalry, artillery, machine gun company, etc. All expenses for the upkeep of these men to be paid from the loan.
(b) Details regarding the supply of munitions to be made separately by Consul "Fee Shang Kur".

C. Economic Relations Between Soviet Russia and Feng Yu Hsiang.

A perusal of the foregoing conditions will convey an idea of the advantages Feng Yu Hsiang receives from having contracted the loan. On the other hand, Soviet Russia, in order to raise funds for propaganda purposes, has stipulated the following economic conditions :-
1. Trading between Soviet Russia and China : Transportation. The following agreement, which has been signed by Soviet Russia and Feng, provides that all transportation by private concerns is illegal, but this right is reserved to national transportation companies, namely:
(a) Soviet National Transportation Bureau,
(b) Mongolian Government offices,
(c) The Yamen of the Tupan of the North-western Territories.
2. Monopoly of Mongolian Trading interests.
The following agreement was signed on September 17 last between Feng Yu Hsiang and "Fee Shang Kur", representing the Soviet Commercial Union :-
(a) That U.S.S.R.'s National Commercial Bureau be given the monopoly of transporting Mongolian products into China.
(b) That the Soviet Commercial Union and the Soviet Commercial Bureau in Mongolia be given the monopoly for transporting Chinese products, such as silk, cotton, shoes, sundry goods, etc. into Mongolia.
(c) All private transactions must be approved by the above-mentioned organizations.
(d) That the Soviet Commercial Union be given preferential treatment in the matter of allotting freight trains on the Peking-Suiyuan Railway.
(e) That the Soviet Commercial Union undertakes to provide money for the maintenance of those members of the Peking-Suiyuan Railway Labour Union who have joined the World Professions League.
(f) That labour unions be established at various places.

- 3 -

2. 贷款金额：5,000,000金卢布。
3. 担保：无具体物品，但规定了以下条件：-
(a) 苏联商业联合会运入中国或经中国转运的俄国和蒙古货物免税。
(b) 授予苏联在中蒙之间货物贸易和运输的垄断权。
4. 偿还条件：五年期限内无需偿还，但必须从第六年开始偿还贷款，并在三年内还清。
5. 贷款用途：该贷款代表购买并供应给冯玉祥的军火价款。
6. 附录：
(a) 除提供军火外，苏联还将派遣21名飞行教官和军官，以及其他骑兵、炮兵、机枪连等的训练员或技工。这些人的所有维持费用将从贷款中支付。
(b) 关于军火供应的细节将由领事“Fee Shang Kur”（音译）另行制定。

C. 苏联与冯玉祥之间的经济关系。

细读上述条件即可了解冯玉祥通过签订贷款所获得的利益。另一方面，苏联为了筹集宣传资金，规定了以下经济条件：-
1. 苏中贸易：运输。苏联与冯玉祥签署了以下协议，规定所有私人企业的运输均为非法，但此权利保留给国家运输公司，即：
(a) 苏联国家运输局，
(b) 蒙古政府机构，
(c) 西北边防督办公署。
2. 蒙古贸易利益的垄断。
冯玉祥与代表苏联商业联合会的“Fee Shang Kur”（音译）于去年9月17日签署了以下协议：-
(a) 授予苏联国家商业局将蒙古产品运入中国的垄断权。
(b) 授予苏联商业联合会和苏联驻蒙古商业局将丝绸、棉花、鞋子、杂货等中国产品运入蒙古的垄断权。
(c) 所有私人交易必须经上述组织批准。
(d) 在京绥铁路分配货运列车方面，给予苏联商业联合会优先待遇。
(e) 苏联商业联合会承诺为加入世界职业联盟的京绥铁路工会成员提供维持经费。
(f) 在各处建立工会。

3. Opium Monopoly.
The sale of opium will also be monopolized conjointly
by Feng Yu Hsiang and Soviet National Commercial
Bureau. The rights to purchase, store, transport
and sell opium in the Special Districts of the North-
west are reserved to the Soviet National Commercial
Bureau. The latter also enjoys the privilege of
importing opium from Turkestan and Persia. Although
the profits are to be equally divided between the
Soviet National Commercial Bureau and Feng Yu Hsiang,
they are nevertheless to be wholly used for revolutionary
purposes. The extent of business conducted last year
was $1,200,000. After deducting $900,000 for brokerage,
the net profit $500,000 (?) was divided, but the methods
of appropriating this sum, according to different
reports, vary. The division of this money caused some
dissatisfaction amongst Feng Yu Hsiang's men. Recently
Feng Yu Hsiang drew $250,000.00 from the Kin Cheng (金城)
Bank and deposited it with the Far Eastern Bank.
It is stated that this money was being held in readiness
for Feng when he goes abroad.

If the foregoing be true, Feng Yu Hsiang has blindly
unconditionally presented the keys of commercial and
economic developments in North China to Soviet Russia,
thereby enabling her to conduct intervention. Soviet
Russia has also supplied Feng with munitions of war in order
to gratify the latter's desires for fighting, thus bringing
about the present heavy fighting in the North. Should
these plans materialize, how can we predict what dangers
the future has in store, especially as Soviet Russia's
real intentions cannot yet be guessed. Soviet Russia may
gradually present demands that will prove even more
unjust than the 21 Demands. Should this actually happen
Feng will naturally accept them willingly. The question
that now remains to be answered is what will be the fate
of China's four hundred million people ? Let the people
think out some means to effect their salvation.

Let us oppose Bolshevism !
Let us oppose Feng Yu Hsiang ↓↓
Let us struggle for national existence !!!
Let us struggle for the lives of the people !!!!

- 4 -

3. 鸦片垄断。
鸦片销售也将由冯玉祥与苏联国家商业局共同垄断。在西北特别区购买、储存、运输和销售鸦片的权利保留给苏联国家商业局。后者还享有从突厥斯坦和波斯进口鸦片的特权。虽然利润将在苏联国家商业局和冯玉祥之间平分，但这些利润将全部用于革命目的。去年的业务规模为1,200,000美元。扣除900,000美元的佣金后，净利润500,000美元（？）进行了分配，但据不同报道，这笔款项的分配方法各异。这笔钱的分配在冯玉祥部下中引起了一些不满。最近，冯玉祥从金城银行提取了250,000.00美元，并存入远东银行。据说这笔钱是为冯玉祥出国时准备的。

如果上述情况属实，冯玉祥已盲目且无条件地将华北商业和经济发展的钥匙献给了苏联，从而使苏联得以进行干涉。苏联还向冯玉祥提供军火，以满足其好战欲望，从而导致了北方目前的激烈战斗。如果这些计划得逞，我们如何预测未来潜藏的危险，尤其是苏联的真实意图尚不可测。苏联可能会逐渐提出比“二十一条”更加不公正的要求。如果这种情况真的发生，冯玉祥自然会乐意接受。现在有待回答的问题是：中国四亿人民的命运将会如何？让民众想出一些自救的办法吧。

让我们反对布尔什维克主义！
让我们反对冯玉祥 ↓↓
让我们为民族生存而奋斗！！！
让我们为人民的生命而奋斗！！！！
